diagnostic_criteria: no CRAB (end-organ damage) or myeloma-defining biomarkers attributable to the plasma cell disorder

biomarkers.name: Serum protein electrophoresis (SPEP) + immunofixation (IFE)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Identifies and quantifies M-spike; IFE determines isotype (IgG, IgA, IgM, IgD, IgE, or light-chain only)

biomarkers.name: Serum free light chains (FLC) + FLC ratio
biomarkers.clinical_use: Abnormal FLC ratio (/b) is a major risk factor for progression to MM or related plasma cell disorders and is part of standard diagnostic/risk assessment

biomarkers.name: Mayo risk stratification (M-spike >15 g/L, non-IgG, abnormal FLC ratio)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Risk factors are serum M-protein >15 g/L, non-IgG isotype, and abnormal FLC ratio. Low-risk (0 factors): repeat at 6 months, then every 2-3 years if stable; higher risk: more frequent monitoring, with bone marrow biopsy/imaging considered based on risk and clinical features

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Minimal marrow plasma cell infiltrate (<10%) with monoclonal Ig production but no end-organ damage or myeloma-defining events
variants: IgM MGUS (precursor to WM/lymphoma rather than MM)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Not graded; Mayo risk stratification for progression

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Pre-malignant state  no myeloma-defining events; many of the same initiating events seen in MM (for non-IgM MGUS, including primary IgH translocations and hyperdiploidy) can be present without progression to symptomatic disease
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Marrow with scattered clonal plasma cells (<10%); no lytic bony lesions

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: For non-IgM MGUS: post-germinal center plasma cells with monoclonal Ig production but limited proliferation; for IgM MGUS: post-germinal center B cell/lymphoplasmacytic lineage
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Mesoderm  lymphoid (mature plasma cells for non-IgM MGUS; lymphoplasmacytic/B-cell lineage for IgM MGUS)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Terminal plasma cell differentiation with monoclonal Ig production in non-IgM MGUS; low tumour burden with preserved marrow function
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Pre-malignant state with initiating events similar to MM in non-IgM MGUS but without progression to full disease phenotype; IgM MGUS is a distinct biologic entity that progresses to WM/lymphoma rather than MM
